items.heading: 八年级下册 Module 10 On the radio
items.topic: 广播节目与梦想；词汇对齐：director / show / show sb. around / on air / avoid / background / national / international / presenter / interview / seem / listener / in person / part-time / article / studio / purpose

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: What do you want to be when you grow up, Leo?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: I want to be a radio presenter. I love talking to people.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: That is a great dream. How did you become interested in the radio?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: I once visited a studio with my father. I watched a presenter interviewing a singer live on air.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Did you meet the director?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Yes. He showed us around the studio, and he explained how the show is made.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: It sounds exciting. I hope you can make your dream come true.

reading.title: A Voice on the Radio
paragraphs: My dream began a long time ago, when I was a small boy. Every morning, my father listened to the radio while he made breakfast. He said that a good voice could travel all over the country, and that words could reach people's hearts.

One day, my father took me to visit a radio station. A friendly presenter gave us a tour. He showed us around the studio, where the microphones stood ready. He also explained how to read the news, how to talk to a guest, and how to avoid making mistakes when the show was on air.

That day I learned something important. A radio show is not just a man talking to a machine. Behind every voice there is a team. There is a director, who plans the show. There are writers, who make the script. There are technicians, who control the background music and the sound.

In the studio, I watched a presenter interview a special guest. They were calm and warm, and they treated each other with respect. The camera and the microphone seemed to disappear. It was just two people talking.

Later, I found out that the presenter also worked part-time as a writer for a national newspaper. In the evening, he wrote articles, and in the morning, he spoke to thousands of listeners. He told me that the purpose of the radio was to connect people, and to bring a little light into their lives.

Now I know what I want to do. I want to be a voice for people, to share good stories, and to bring people together. Whether it is a small school show or an international station, I will keep working for my dream.

words.sentence: He showed us around the studio...

items.heading: 八年级下册 Module 1 Feelings and impressions
items.topic: 感觉与印象（系动词）；词汇对齐：smell / soft / sour / pizza / lovely / done / try / Have a try / pie / sound / sweet tooth / salt / jam / favourite / ear / glasses / jeans / fair / pretty / proud / be proud of / stranger / message / can't wait

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: This soup smells delicious. Did you make it yourself?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Yes. I tried a new recipe. Would you like to have a try?

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: Sure! ... Mmm, it tastes lovely. Is there sugar in it?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: A little. I have a sweet tooth, so I added some jam.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: It looks a little soft, but it's really good. What about this pie?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: That one is still in the oven. Wait until dinner!

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: I can't wait. You are great at cooking, Tom. I'm proud of you.

reading.title: A Friend's First Visit
paragraphs: My pen friend Ella is coming to visit me for the first time. I am a little nervous, because I want her to have a good impression of my town and my family.
This morning, I went to the station to meet her. The moment I saw her, I knew it was Ella. She had fair hair and wore round glasses and blue jeans. She looked friendly and a little shy.

I took her home. The whole kitchen was full of a sweet smell, because my mother was making an apple pie. Ella said she loved it, and she asked for the recipe right away. She has a sweet tooth, just like me.

At dinner, we talked about many things. Ella told me about her school, and I told her about mine. She was a little nervous about meeting my parents, but they were very kind, and soon she felt at home.

The best moment came after dinner. My father played a song, and Ella began to sing along softly. It sounded wonderful, and everybody smiled. In that moment, I knew we would be good friends for a long time.
First impressions are important, but they are only the beginning. The real friendship shows itself little by little, in the small, warm moments we share.

words.sentence: Would you like to have a try?

items.heading: 八年级下册 Module 2 Experiences
items.topic: 经历（现在完成时）；词汇对齐：ever / enter / competition / prize / first prize / dream / afford / write about / make up / invite / move / send / Germany / France / tower / ancient / king / queen / Arabic / way / mix / miss / count / count down

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: Have you ever entered a writing competition?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Yes, I have. Last year I entered one and won the first prize!

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: That's amazing! What did you write about?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: I wrote about my dream of visiting France. I described the ancient towers and how I would mix with the local people.

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: Did they give you a prize?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: They sent me a book and an invitation to a writing club. I couldn't afford to travel, but the prize was still great.

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: I have never entered one. Maybe I should try.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: You should. Everyone has a story to tell.

reading.title: A Dream Comes True
paragraphs: Have you ever dreamed of seeing the world? Many of us have. Some dreams stay in our hearts for years, and then, unexpectedly, they come true.

My friend Lena always loved stories about other countries. When she was a child, she used to read about France and Germany, and she imagined herself walking through the streets of Paris. She wished she could visit the Eiffel Tower or stand in front of an ancient castle. But money was short, and her family could not afford such a long trip.

Then one day, her school announced a writing competition. The topic was "My Dream Journey." Lena was excited. She wrote about a trip she had never taken: walking by a river, speaking a little Arabic to a shopkeeper, and watching the sun go down behind an old tower. She made up many of the details, but she wrote every word with her heart.
To her surprise, Lena won the first prize. The prize was a trip to France, together with a group of students. She could not believe her eyes. After years of dreaming, she was finally going.

In France, Lena saw everything she had written about. It did not feel like a dream. It felt like coming home. Since that trip, she has written three more stories, and she has started a small blog to share her experiences.
Lena says that we should never stop dreaming. A dream may seem impossible, but if we work for it, it can come true. You have not missed your chance yet. Count down the days, and start today.

words.sentence: She made up many of the details.
(拓展) move to a new city

items.heading: 八年级下册 Module 3 Journey to space
items.topic: 太空探索（现在完成时）；词汇对齐：earth / moon / news / planet / reach / yet / just / model / spaceship / project / no problem / latest / discover / astronaut / space travel / none / environment / solar / system / group / galaxy / universe / light / impossible

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Have you heard the latest news? A new spaceship has just reached the Moon.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Really? I have read about space travel before, but I have never seen a real spacecraft.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Our science club is building a model of a rocket. Would you like to join?

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Yes! I have always wanted to learn about the solar system.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Great. We will look at the planets and the stars in the galaxy.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: It sounds like a wonderful project. Maybe one day we will even find life on another planet.

reading.title: New Worlds
paragraphs: For thousands of years, people have looked up at the night sky and wondered what is out there. Today, that wonder has become a journey into space.

The first rockets carried only animals and simple instruments. Then, in 1961, a human went into space for the first time. It was a moment that changed history. Since then, astronauts have travelled further and further. They have walked on the Moon, sent machines to other planets, and built space stations that circle the Earth.

Space is very different from our home. There is no air, and the temperature can be very hot or very cold. Because of this, astronauts have to wear special suits and carry their own oxygen. They have to learn to work, eat and sleep in a tiny space. It is not an easy life, but it is an exciting one.

Our project at school is about the solar system. We have made a small model of the eight planets, and we have placed a tiny sun in the middle. We have learned that the Earth is one of eight planets, and that the Moon travels around it. We have also learned about the galaxy we live in, and about the universe of stars and planets beyond it.

We have not discovered life on other planets yet. Some scientists believe it is possible, while others think it is impossible. On this question, the journey is not over. Every new spaceship, every new telescope and every new photograph brings us a little closer to the answer.
Maybe one day, one of us will travel to the stars.

words.sentence: ...the Earth is one of eight planets...
We have not discovered life yet.

items.heading: 八年级下册 Module 4 Seeing the doctor
items.topic: 健康与就医（现在完成时 + since/for）；词汇对齐：cough / fever / headache / ache / toothache / ill / since / catch a cold / take sb.'s temperature / fast food / health / well / heart / active / pet / member / take part in / condition / in excellent condition / sleepy / daily / weak

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good morning. What's the matter?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: I have a cough and a headache. I've felt ill since Monday.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Let me take your temperature. ... You have a fever. Have you caught a cold?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: I think so. It was raining, and I stayed outside for a long time.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: You haven't been feeling well. Have you eaten fast food a lot?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: Yes, I have. I eat it almost every day.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: That's not healthy. You should eat well and take part in sports.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: I will, doctor. Thank you.

reading.title: Look After Yourself
paragraphs: Health is the most important thing we have. We often do not think about it until we become ill, and then it is too late. A doctor can help us when we are sick, but the best medicine is a good habit.

Many students these days do not move enough. They sit at their desks for hours, eat fast food, and go to bed very late. Soon they catch a cold easily, or they get a headache and a cough. Their body becomes weak, and they feel sleepy all day.

The good news is that a healthy life is not difficult. First, eat well. Eat vegetables and fruit, and drink enough water. Do not take too much sugar or too much salt. Second, be active. Take part in sports or go for a walk every day. This makes your heart strong and keeps you in excellent condition. Third, sleep enough. Your body needs rest to repair itself, especially after a long day of school.

Doctors also say that our feelings are a part of our health. When we are worried or sad, we may feel ill. So it is important to talk to someone and to enjoy the simple things in life. A pet or a friend can be a great help.
If you have a fever or a toothache, do not wait. See a doctor early, and take the medicine you are given. But remember: the best way to stay well is to look after yourself every day.

words.sentence: Health is the most important thing.
A pet can be a great help.

items.heading: 八年级下册 Module 5 Cartoon stories
items.topic: 卡通故事；词汇对齐：cartoon / handsome / smart / sky / fight / cool / hero / humorous / can't help doing / laugh / lesson / orange-and-white / ugly / win the heart of / schoolbag / lead / clever / mess / heaven / expect / artist / invent / copy / black-and-white / own

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: What are you watching, Tom?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: A cartoon about a brave cat. He fights the bad guys and always saves the day.

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: Is he cool?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Yes! He is smart and humorous, and he has a strong heart. He wins the hearts of everyone.

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: I like cartoons, too. They are funny, but they also teach us lessons.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Right. A good cartoon can make us laugh and think at the same time.

reading.title: The Little Hero
paragraphs: Everyone loves a good story, and cartoons are stories in pictures. They are funny, colourful and full of action. But a really good cartoon is much more than a child's game.

Think about a little cat who is not big or strong. He is a little ugly, and his home is a small corner under the roof. But he has a smart mind and a kind heart. Every day, he helps the people around him. He saves a lost child, he leads his friends out of a mess, and he fights the trouble that comes to the house.

People love this cat because he is not perfect. He is like us. He makes mistakes, and sometimes he is afraid. But when something is wrong, he stands up and tries. He is humorous, too. Even in a dangerous moment, he finds something to laugh about. That is why he has won the hearts of so many people.

Some cartoons have been with us for a very long time. They appear again and again, in books, in films, even on schoolbags. An artist once invented a character, and then copied the same idea for years. Some stories are shown in black-and-white, but the feelings are still bright.
Cartoons are a gift. They give us a few minutes of joy and a memory that stays with us. They may be simple, but they carry a big lesson: be brave, be kind, and never give up.

words.sentence: A cartoon about a brave cat.
An artist once invented a character...
...won the hearts of so many people.

items.heading: 八年级下册 Module 6 Hobbies
items.topic: 兴趣爱好；词汇对齐：fan / stamp / tidy up / shelf / have a look / coin / note / pound / dollar / must / valuable / value / person / interest / skill / activity / sailing / come out / result / as a result / pleasure / success / encourage

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: What do you do in your free time, Leo?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: I collect stamps. My grandfather started it, and it has become my interest too.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Do they have much value?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Some are quite valuable, but for me, the pleasure is in the collection itself.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Have a look at my shelf - I have some old coins and notes from different places.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Wow! That's a great collection. Hobbies are useful, because they teach us new skills.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: And they help us enjoy life. As a result, we become more positive people.

reading.title: Hobbies Make Us Grow
paragraphs: Everybody has a hobby. It can be a sport, a game, a collection or a craft. Some people like to sail, some love to play music, and some enjoy making things with their hands.

A hobby is more than a way to pass the time. It teaches us useful skills and can even lead to success. My cousin Tom started to collect stamps when he was six. He learned to read about different countries, to be careful with his things, and to keep his collection tidy. He was always happy to tidy up the shelf and show visitors his latest pieces.

Over the years, Tom's collection grew. Some stamps were not worth much, but a few were very valuable. He once found a rare stamp at a small shop for only a few pounds. He took a photo and posted it online. The news came out, and many collectors wanted to buy it. Tom chose to keep it, because it was part of his story.

As a result, Tom became a kind of expert. People asked for his advice, and he started to write a small blog about stamps. He encouraged other students to start their own collections. In this way, a simple hobby opened many doors for him.
Of course, we should not let a hobby take up all our time. School is important, and a hobby is a part of life, not the whole of it.
A hobby is like a friend. It entertains us, it teaches us, and it gives us pleasure and confidence. Whatever you love to do, keep doing it. It may become something great.

words.sentence: Have a look at my shelf...
As a result, Tom became an expert.

items.heading: 八年级下册 Module 7 Summer in Los Angeles
items.topic: 夏令营与文化课程；词汇对齐：list / make a list / crazy / at the end of / shorts / trousers / sunglasses / homestay / weigh / total / weight / passport / culture / at the same time / last / depend / depend on / provide / test / guest / daily life / form / friendship / stay in touch with / prefer / certain

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Have you decided to join the summer camp in LA?

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: Yes, I have. My parents have already paid for it.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: What do you need to prepare?

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: I need my passport, and I have made a list of things to take, like sunglasses and shorts.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Will you stay in a hotel?

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: No, I will have a homestay with an American family. It is a good way to learn about their daily life.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: That sounds great. I prefer home life, but it is a wonderful chance to practise my English.

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: It is. In the end, I hope to make lifelong friends.

reading.title: My Summer in Los Angeles
paragraphs: This summer, I am going to Los Angeles with a group of students for a language camp. I have never been abroad before, so I am both excited and a little nervous.

Before I go, I have a lot to do. First, I need to get my passport ready. I have also made a list of everything I need: sunglasses for the sun, shorts and trousers, a pair of good shoes, and a small camera. My suitcase has become quite heavy, so I will have to weigh it at the airport. I cannot take too much, because there is a total weight limit.

The best part of the trip is the homestay. I will live with an American family, and in this way, I can learn about their daily life. In the morning, I will have breakfast with them, and at night, I will tell them about my day. They will provide me with a warm room and good food, and I will help them a little at the same time. This is a wonderful way to build true friendship.

During the day, we will take English classes and do fun activities. We will visit interesting places, take a trip to the sea, and work in small groups. At the end of the course, there will be a test, but I am not worried. The most important thing is to speak and to enjoy myself.

Some of my friends think I am a little crazy to go so far away. But I know that this month will last in my memory for a lifetime. I cannot wait to make new friends and to see the world. This trip depends on nothing but my own courage, and I am ready for the adventure.

words.sentence: At the end of the course...
I will have to weigh it...
This trip depends on nothing but courage.
...depends on nothing but my own courage...
They will provide me with a warm room...
I will stay in touch with them.

items.heading: 八年级下册 Module 8 Time off
items.topic: 度假与休闲；词汇对齐：hardly / take up / point out / sights / thirsty / at the top of / waste / square / kilometre / shape / human / wake / wake sb. up / somebody / about / path / pull / freshwater / woken

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: What do you like to do when you have time off, Tom?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: I go to the mountains. There are so many wonderful sights up there.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Is it hard to climb?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: A little. The path is long, and sometimes I am thirsty and tired. But when I reach the top, the view is amazing.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Can you see the whole town from there?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Yes. The lake below is a perfect shape, and the square is as small as a stamp.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: That sounds lovely. I waste too much time sitting at home. Maybe I should get up and go outside too.

reading.title: A Day in the Mountains
paragraphs: My family loves the mountains. Whenever we have time off, we put on our shoes, take a little water, and walk along the path into the hills.

Last Saturday, we set out early. The morning air was cool and fresh, and the birds were singing. We climbed for hours. The path was steep, and I was hot and thirsty. "I hardly have any strength left," I said. "Can we rest?"
My father pointed at the top. "Not yet," he said. "The best sights are at the top of the mountain."

So we kept going. Along the way, we saw a small stream of clear freshwater. We stopped and drank, and the water was cold and sweet. We also saw a little animal that pulled something across the path. It was a beautiful day to be outside.

At last, we reached the top. The town below looked like a small toy. The lake was a big, round shape, and the square was as small as a coin. For a moment, I forgot all my worries. I stood there, feeling tiny but very happy.

Somebody once said that we should wake up each day and enjoy the world. I now understand what that means. When we are busy, we forget to look around. But when we take time off, we remember how beautiful the earth is.
On the way home, I felt tired but happy. The day was not wasted at all.

words.sentence: There are so many wonderful sights...
...the square was as small as a coin.
The day was not wasted at all.
I hardly have any strength left.
My father pointed at the top.（point out）
We should wake up each day...

items.heading: 八年级下册 Module 9 Friendship
items.topic: 友谊（宾语从句）；词汇对齐：helpline / separate / explain / refuse / treat / herself / whether / lonely / regret / introduce / join in / no problem / silence / in silence / pass / bright / treasure / day by day / trust / include / circle / stick / glue / suggestion / patient

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: You look quiet. Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I had a fight with my best friend. I regret what I said to her.

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: It is hard to lose a friend. Have you tried to explain your feelings?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I did, but she refused to talk. I feel so lonely now.

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: Give her a little time. Trust that the friendship can be mended. A good suggestion is to write her a note.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: You are right. I will try to talk to her again tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: Be patient, and things will get better day by day.

reading.title: A Friend Worth Keeping
paragraphs: True friendship is one of the most beautiful treasures in life. A good friend is with us in the bright days and in the dark ones. But friendship is not always easy. Sometimes there are misunderstandings, and sometimes we hurt the people we love.

My friend Lucy and I have known each other since we were little. We used to do everything together. Then one day, we had a small fight over a project. I wanted to do it my way, and she wanted to do it hers. We both said things we did not mean, and then we stopped talking.

For a few days, we kept our silence. It was a sad time. I felt lonely and I did not know what to do. I told my mother about it, and she gave me some advice. She said, "Do not let a small thing separate you. You should explain how you feel and listen to her, too."

So I did as she suggested. I wrote a note to Lucy, and I passed it to her after class. I wrote that I was sorry and that I valued our friendship. She read it, and she smiled at me. That afternoon, we walked home together and talked for a long time.
That day I learned that friendship needs trust and patience. We have to be kind, even when we are angry. And we have to build the bond again, day by day, like glue that holds two pieces together.
Lucy is still my best friend. Our friendship has survived, and it is stronger now. I know that whatever happens, we will find a way to be friends again.

words.sentence: Do not let a small thing separate you.
She wanted to do it hers.（herself 相关）
A good suggestion is to write...
